name: image-studio
description: Opt-in image endpoint. One picture from a prompt, saved under a name that ends in .png.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generates a real image from a text description and saves a file whose name ends in .png. Use this when the user wants an image, an illustration or a photo motif. Runs via an OpenAI-compatible /images/generations endpoint. Provide a detailed English image description. An empty prompt or a missing endpoint returns an error line and no file.

changelog: 1.2.0 - generate_image asks the host. The prompt stays out of the bridge row. The skill prompt carries an output contract and a quality gate.
